- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5815-5819 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `prose()` does not neutralize HTML comments or machine-marker prefixes in model-controlled advisory prose.
  WHY: Injected markers can be treated as authoritative by raw-body reconciliation and deduplication, causing a follow-up to match the wrong finding or be suppressed.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:1928-1937 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `quoted_evidence()` leaves HTML comments and machine-marker strings intact in model-controlled weekly follow-up text.
  WHY: Injected markers can poison `existing_waiver_keys` or other marker-based reconciliation and suppress or misassociate genuine follow-ups.

- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:259-267, 382-384 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Generated-advisory mode uses descendant-aware `entry_matches`, so a directory-shaped `cited_file` such as `src` authorizes all `src/**` paths instead of exactly one file.
  WHY: `_strict_repository_file` accepts bare directory names and the implement-time guard is weaker than the exact-file contract enforced by the plan-side check.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4681-4707 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_security_pass_state_fields` filters every `security_pass_advisory_backlog` row requiring a valid `waiver_match_key`.
  WHY: Pre-rollout queued advisories lack that field and are silently discarded on the first post-deployment poll instead of being migrated or preserved.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:1946-1988 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `existing_finding_ids` is collected from legacy `ai:security-finding:<id>` markers but the deduplication condition checks only `waiver_match_key in existing_waiver_keys`.
  WHY: Pre-change follow-up issues with only legacy markers are treated as absent, causing duplicate follow-ups after rollout.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5742-5746 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The key-migration guard returns success when `waiver_match_key` is empty and `merged_pr` is empty or non-numeric, silently skipping keyless advisory creation.
  WHY: Immediate filing callers do not pass `merged_pr`, so keyless findings can be discarded without an issue or diagnostic.

- scripts/security_audit.sh:1127 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The run log still reports `waived-findings=<count> (line window <N>)` although waiver matching now uses only `waiver_match_key`.
  WHY: Operators are given a misleading suppression rule while diagnosing security-audit results.

- changelog.d/security-pass-integrity-hardening.md:1 (filename) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment filename lacks the required `<issue-or-pr>-` prefix.
  WHY: It violates the per-PR fragment naming contract and can collide with another fragment using the same slug.
